title: Not Afraid
statementMd:
Since the giant heads have appeared in the sky all humanity is in danger, so **all** Ricks and Mortys from all parallel universes are gathering in groups to find a solution to get rid of them.

There are $*n*$ parallel universes participating in this event ($*n*$ Ricks and $*n*$ Mortys). I. e. each of $*n*$ universes has one Rick and one Morty. They're gathering in $*m*$ groups. Each person can be in many groups and a group can contain an arbitrary number of members.

Ricks and Mortys have registered online in these groups. So, a person can have joined a group more than once (developer of this website hadn't considered this possibility).

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/8e28eeaa0567268e4a80f777c0a60c6bc0071709.png)

Summer from universe #1 knows that in each parallel universe (including hers) exactly one of Rick and Morty from that universe is a traitor and is loyal, but no one knows which one. She knows that we are doomed if there's a group such that every member in that group is a traitor (they will plan and destroy the world).

Summer knows that if there's a possibility that world ends (there's a group where all members are traitors) she should immediately cancel this event. So she wants to know if she should cancel the event. You have to tell her yes if and only if there's at least one scenario (among all $2^{*n*}$ possible scenarios, $2$ possible scenarios for who a traitor in each universe) such that in that scenario the world will end.

## Input

The first line of input contains two integers $*n*$ and $*m*$ ($1 ≤ *n*, *m* ≤ 10^{4}$) — number of universes and number of groups respectively.

The next $*m*$ lines contain the information about the groups. $*i*$-th of them first contains an integer $*k*$ (number of times someone joined $*i*$-th group, $*k* > 0$) followed by $*k*$ integers $*v*_{*i*, 1}, *v*_{*i*, 2}, ..., *v*_{*i*, *k*}$. If $*v*_{*i*, *j*}$ is negative, it means that Rick from universe number $- *v*_{*i*, *j*}$ has joined this group and otherwise it means that Morty from universe number $*v*_{*i*, *j*}$ has joined it.

Sum of $*k*$ for all groups does not exceed $10^{4}$.

## Output

In a single line print the answer to Summer's question. Print "`YES`" if she should cancel the event and "`NO`" otherwise.

## Note

In the first sample testcase, $1$st group only contains the Rick from universe number $3$, so in case he's a traitor, then all members of this group are traitors and so Summer should cancel the event.
statementZhMd:
自从巨大的头颅出现在天空中，全人类都陷入了危险，因此来自所有平行宇宙的 **所有** Rick 和 Morty 都在分组集合，试图找到摆脱它们的方法。

共有 $*n*$ 个平行宇宙参加此次活动（$*n*$ 个 Rick 和 $*n*$ 个 Morty）。也就是说，每个 $*n*$ 个宇宙中都有一个 Rick 和一个 Morty。他们被分成了 $*m*$ 个组。每个人可以加入多个组，一个组也可以包含任意数量的成员。

Rick 和 Morty 在线注册加入了这些组。因此，一个人可能多次加入同一个组（这个网站的开发者没有考虑到这种情况）。

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/8e28eeaa0567268e4a80f777c0a60c6bc0071709.png)

来自 1 号宇宙的 Summer 知道，在每个平行宇宙（包括她所在的宇宙）中，来自该宇宙的 Rick 和 Morty 恰好有一个是叛徒，另一个是忠诚者，但没有人知道究竟是哪一个。她知道，如果存在一个组，使得该组中的每个成员都是叛徒，那么世界就会毁灭（他们会策划并摧毁世界）。

Summer 知道，只要存在世界毁灭的可能性（存在一个所有成员都是叛徒的组），她就应该立即取消这次活动。因此，她想知道自己是否应该取消活动。请你在且仅在至少存在一种情形（在全部 $2^{*n*}$ 种可能的情形中，每个宇宙中谁是叛徒有 $2$ 种选择），使得世界会毁灭时，回答她 `YES`。

## 输入格式

输入的第一行包含两个整数 $*n*$ 和 $*m*$（$1 ≤ *n*, *m* ≤ 10^{4}$）——宇宙的数量和组的数量。

接下来的 $*m*$ 行包含各组的信息。第 $*i*$ 行首先包含一个整数 $*k*$（有人加入第 $*i*$ 个组的次数，$*k* > 0$），随后包含 $*k*$ 个整数 $*v*_{*i*, 1}, *v*_{*i*, 2}, ..., *v*_{*i*, *k*}$。如果 $*v*_{*i*, *j}$ 为负数，则表示来自编号为 $- *v*_{*i*, *j}$ 的宇宙的 Rick 加入了该组；否则表示来自编号为 $*v*_{*i*, *j}$ 的宇宙的 Morty 加入了该组。

所有组的 $*k*$ 之和不超过 $10^{4}$。

## 输出格式

在一行中输出 Summer 的问题的答案。如果她应该取消活动，输出 `YES`；否则输出 `NO`。

## 说明

在第一个样例中，第 1 个组只包含来自 3 号宇宙的 Rick，因此如果他是叛徒，那么该组的所有成员都是叛徒，Summer 就应该取消活动。
